description:
BM25 full-text search over items (no body returned, token-light).

Ranked by weighted BM25 (SQLite FTS5) over the title, the original-language summary,
the English summary, sentence-free English search signals and — for items whose
license permits redistribution — the body.
Japanese text is morphologically segmented at index time, so Japanese queries match
words that a substring search would miss. Results carry score (0-1), rank and a
snippet of the matching passage. Use portal_get to read a matched item's body.

Args:
    q: keyword(s). space-separated terms are ANDed. e.g. "openai gpt"
    category: category prefix match. e.g. "news" or "security"
    status: filter by ingested/processed/enriched/published (all if omitted)
    source: feed identifier. e.g. "ghost-chinng-lab"
    lang: original language. e.g. "ja"
    limit: number of results (default 20, max 100)
    offset: paging start position
    mode: "bm25" (default, relevance-ranked) or "index" (substring match, newest first)

Returns:
    {total, count, limit, offset, query, mode, total_is_capped, items[]} — same
    license-gated item shape as portal_list (summary/summary_en and snippet omitted
    for link-only, omission reason and search signals retained), **never the body**.
    In bm25 mode each item adds score / rank /
    snippet, and total is an estimate capped for cost. If the BM25 index is not
    usable the call transparently falls back to mode "index" and reports why in
    degraded_reason.
name: portal_search
